Subject:	Reports on GTC Cluster

For "back door" access to EOL Reports, please follow the steps outlined below:

Go to http://remoteservices.enron.com
Choose EnronOnline GTC Loader Cluster from the drop down list
Login using your regular NT account
Choose Start-->Programs-->Windows NT Explorer
Navigate to c:\ClickTrade\Reports
Double Click on Reports
Login to Reports as normal
